note: DTD technical panel corrected against the consensus code. Four things it got wrong: (1) the header cells still counted the draw cadence as '1 of 3', but since V15 at #25,000 is_lottery_block() returns true for EVERY block - 3-of-3 - which is why blocks whose height is not a multiple of 3 pay DTD; a third cadence row now shows that and section 8 explains the three eras instead of describing three non-existent 'payout streams'. (2) Eligibility was described as a lifetime flag that is never reset - it has not been one since V15: the block must be recent (5,000 / 20,000 at a jackpot height), and from #30,000 within the last 288 at every height. (3) The prize was described as a pool that accumulates while no payout is made; a PAYOUT block actually pays this block's own DTD share PLUS anything pending, and pending only grows on an UPDATE_EMPTY block. (4) The anti-dominance note still described the pre-V15 25%+25% protocol share, and did not say that from #30,000 the gate is armed only at 11 or more distinct miners, nor that the cooldown yields rather than emptying the draw. Also corrected: the winner seed is a single domain-separated SHA-256 over the 16 preceding BLOCK HASHES plus the height, and the reference implementation is src/lottery.cpp, not src/pow/casert.cpp (that file is the difficulty controller). A new section 9 states that from #30,000 the Jackpot V2 leaves this draw and becomes independent. Software: v16.2.0, which changes no consensus rule; update window unchanged - node AND miner, after #29,900 and before #30,000.
